items.headline: Dennis Franchione, coach at Texas A&M, Alabama, TCU, dies at 75
items.description: Dennis Franchione, whose 40-year college football coaching career included stops at Texas A&M, Alabama and TCU, has died at the age of 75.

items.headline: Hawkins' 96-yard KOR for TD, Cooper's pick-6 help San Diego State beat Texas State 31-29
items.description: — Jaylon Hawkins returned the opening kickoff of the second half for a touchdown, Cameron Cooper had a 32-yard pick-6, and short-handed San Diego State beat Texas State 31-29 on Saturday night in the inaugural Pac-12 Conference game for both teams.

items.headline: Brady Jackson throws 5 TD passes, Texas State beats Incarnate Word 63-10
items.description: — Brad Jackson threw five first-half touchdown passes, Torrance Burgess Jr. had 140 yards rushing and a TD on nine carries, and Texas State beat Incarnate Word 63-10 on Saturday night.
